source_snapshot.title: Sharjah’s Al Dhaid Bridge set to open on November 15 as final works near completion
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Sharjah’s Al Dhaid Bridge is set to open to traffic on November 15, with final construction works nearing completion on the 320-metre structure designed to improve traffic flow and connectivity in the emirate’s Central Region.The Sharjah Roads and Transport Authority (SRTA), in cooperation with the Sharjah Initiatives Implementation Authority (Mubadara), is putting the finishing touches on the project ahead of its scheduled opening..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..The bridge is expected to enhance traffic movement and provide smoother connections between key routes in Al Dhaid, forming part of wider efforts to modernise the region’s road network and infrastructure, as announced during the Direct Line programme..Viewers were also given a glimpse of the bridge's design and architectural features through images shown during the Direct Line programme on Sharjah Radio and TelevisionBeyond its transport function, the bridge features four lifts, balconies and dedicated viewing areas overlooking Al Dhaid Lake beneath the structure, combining improved mobility with recreational and architectural features.The project is in line with the development vision of His Highness Sheikh Dr Sultan bin Mohammed Al Qasimi, Supreme Council Member and Ruler of Sharjah, to strengthen infrastructure, support urban development and improve quality of life across the emirate.The authority said it continues to coordinate with relevant government entities to implement road development projects across Sharjah, focusing on improving road safety, traffic efficiency and connectivity to meet the needs of the emirate’s growing communities..Sharjah completes Dh30 million Al Hisn Island Bridge in Dibba Al Hisn.Sharjah launches Dh750m road project to ease Dubai commute, first opening due in November 2026.Dh750 million Sharjah–Dubai road projects to ease traffic, boost connectivity.Sharjah Ruler approves Dh140 million bridge linking Khalifa bin Zayed Road to Maliha Road

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: The Al Dhaid Bridge in Sharjah will open on November 15.
The Al Dhaid Bridge is 320 meters long.
The bridge will improve transport communication and connectivity between key routes in the emirate's central region.
The project includes four lifts, balconies, and viewing platforms overlooking Al Dhaid Lake, combining transport function with architectural and recreational elements.

summary_ru: 🚇 Мост Аль-Дхайд в Шардже откроют 15 ноября 📅 В Шардже завершаются работы на мосту Аль-Дхайд длиной 320 метров, который откроют для движения 15 ноября. Мост улучшит транспортное сообщение и связь между ключевыми маршрутами в центральном регионе эмирата. Проект включает четыре лифта, балконы и смотровые площадки с видом на озеро Аль-Дхайд, сочетая транспортную функцию с архитектурными и рекреационными элементами.
